Resolves #20420

`CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs` now waits for the month view's mount scroll to land before it measures the event. It then asserts that the press point hits that event before pressing.

The view scrolls to the active month after it mounts (`updateHeaderHeight(true)`). A measurement taken before that scroll is stale by the time the pointer presses. That is the `neo-drag-active` red on about half of tonight's `e2e-engine (4/4)` shards. The change is test-only.

Evidence: L3 (local Chrome: one discriminator run on both procedures, plus the fixed spec 10/10) → L3 required (#20420's AC-2 is that discriminator).

Micro-review eligible: test-only — one spec waits for its own precondition; no engine change.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/CalendarMonthEventDrag.spec.mjs` polls the scroll container until `scrollTop` equals its height minus the `.neo-days-header` height. It then asserts that `elementFromPoint` at the press point is the measured event. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI: the discriminator under Test Evidence. With the view's scroll delayed, the base procedure missed 6 of 6 and the fixed one missed 0 of 6. At natural timing: 3 of 22 against 0 of 22. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: this PR's `e2e-engine` shard runs the spec. |

## Deltas from ticket
- The discriminator adds a slow-runner timing: the page delays the view's `Neo.main.DomAccess.scrollTo` by 300 ms. Natural timing misses only 3 in 22 on this machine, so both procedures ran under both timings.

## Test Evidence
The discriminator was an untracked probe spec, deleted after the runs. It ran in local branded Chrome under `playwright.config.e2e.mjs` with `--workers=1`. Each arm measures the first month event as its procedure does, pauses 400 ms, then reads the element under the press point.

| Procedure | Natural timing | View's scroll delayed 300 ms |
|---|---|---|
| Base: measure after `toBeVisible` | 3 misses of 22 | 6 misses of 6 |
| Fixed: wait for the scroll target first | 0 misses of 22 | 0 misses of 6 |

In every miss, `scrollTop` read 548 at the measurement and 578 at the press. The press point then lay over the next event (`…__2` instead of `…__1`). The fixed spec itself passed 10 of 10 at head.
